ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. This online course for students in the Macomb cohort begins on Thursday August 25th, and ends on Thursday December 8th. This online course uses both Compass (course management system) for asynchronous and Elluminate for synchronous sessions. Students are highly recommended to have a reliable high-speed Internet connection and a microphone or headset with microphone are required for this course. A couple face to face sessions for this course may be scheduled and location and additional information provided to students.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $452.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
